svg.title: Queen of Sidney - British Columbia Ferries sticker reconstruction
svg.desc: Editable manually constructed vector artwork based on the supplied vintage sticker. All lettering is outlined. Flat colours replace paper grain and photographic lighting; the exterior is transparent. Source coordinate canvas: 1305 by 1206. No embedded bitmap or auto-traced contour data.
